title: Telegram route rate-limit test still depends on an hour of real time, and the limiter's test relies on saturating Instant arithmetic
outcome: telegram_test_route_rate_limit_includes_retry_after_header reaches a rate-limited route without any dependence on elapsed real time and without relying on Instant::duration_since saturating, for example through a controlled clock for the route path, or the decision is recorded that an hour's margin is enough.
acceptance: The route test's verdict no longer depends on real time passing, or a note records why the one-hour margin stands
The route test still fails if the route stops applying its rate limit, shown by a recorded failing run
